gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Rough-hewn and bossy, Unkempt draws its t with a crossbar as hefty as the stem, while Noto Sans Cypro Minoan trims its terminals back. Paragraphs stay light and breathable.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohin: Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya has a visibly gaping c that stays open at any size, and Unkempt shouts above it. Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya gives the pair its friendliest quality: an approachable, modern text voice.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-hatran: A pen that never shifts its pressure or angle makes Unkempt look hand-cut and commanding, with Noto Sans Hatran beneath. Enlarge Noto Sans Hatran a notch if its funnel-wide e feels small.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-inscriptiona: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi, whose small counters stay unclogged. And Unkempt, expressive and steady in weight from word to word, gives it a loud neighbor that never crowds it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Unkempt draws everything with flat, unmodulated line weight. Noto Sans Javanese sits underneath with apertures that keep each counter connected to the space outside, so the loud top and the quiet text share a page easily.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Strokes of one width, like laser-cut sheet, give Unkempt its bold, commanding stamp. And Noto Sans Kawi, with its open-jawed c like pliers, is the clean sans-serif foil that makes the pair work.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Clean lines define Noto Sans Linear A, whose gaping c stays visible at any size. And you can nudge its size up without touching Unkempt, which already strokes along with one fixed nib.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Unkempt has a single-weight outline feel, loud and a bit scruffy on the page. Noto Sans Linear B takes over with a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend, and that smoothness is the strongest pull.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Modern and clean, this sans-serif text face opens the crossbars of its e with open mouths while Unkempt, with stroke ends as wide as the middle, roars overhead. Noto Sans Manichaean makes the pair's best quality plain: rough on top, easy to take in below.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-nko: Noto Sans NKo keeps its c openings clear enough to see through, which makes it a modern sans-serif text face. But Unkempt does the shouting best, with diagonals carrying the same heft as its stems.
